# Ella Creations - Full Agentic Catalog & Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

## Product Specifications & Materials
Every creation crafted by Ella Creations adheres to the following luxury benchmarks:
- **Metal Matrix**: Skin-compatible brass with micron gold flash electroplating. Hypoallergenic nickel-free.
- **Gemstones**:
  - Kundan: Uncut Polki glass stones set in gold-foiled bezels.
  - Cubic Zirconia: High refractive index AAA+ CZ stones cut with 57 brilliant facets.
  - Pearls: Premium faux South Sea & cultured baroque imitation pearls.
- **Packaging**: Hard-box jewelry case with anti-moisture silica sachet and care booklet.
- **Optional Upgrades**:
  - Luxury Velvet Presentation Box (+₹199)
  - Extended Anti-Tarnish Polish Kit (+₹299)
  - Silk Brocade Travel Pouch (+₹149)
  - Handwritten Calligraphy Message Card (+₹99)
  - Express Gift Wrap with Wax Seal (+₹120)

## Ordering & Logistics
- Standard Delivery: 3 - 5 business days across India.
- Express Delivery: 24 - 48 hours to major metros (Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata).
- Free Shipping threshold: Orders above ₹999.
- Tracking: Integrated real-time tracking updates via SMS & WhatsApp.
